scope: Research-only P1 hybrid symmetric-stress Stokes, RT1 divergence-preserving load, static condensation and sparse global solve. No convection or production/default change. Physical cylinder case uses no-slip EmbeddedBoundary and uniform (1,0) on the complete DomainBoundary, NOT the original Re20 outlet or nonlinear equations.

method.spaces: P1 cell/face velocity, P1 cell pressure; original P1 weak gradient and same B/-B^T. Velocity potential P2 for reporting/stabilisation, not claimed pointwise divergence-free.
method.viscosity: 2 nu integral epsilon(G(u)):epsilon(G(v)) plus original P2-consistent face projection stabilisation scaled nu length/diameter. nu=1 m^2/s. Constant pressure gauge only, no pressure stabilization block.
method.load: Triangle Piola RT1 on original centroid fan, matching both moments of every atom-face normal trace, both moments on each internal radial trace, and cell P1 weak divergence as the same polynomial on every subtriangle. One redundant radial mean omitted then checked. Remaining freedom minimises integral |R(v)-v_T|^2. Nonpositive fan rejects the research implementation without altering product geometry or gate.
method.condensation: Eliminate six cell velocity DOFs and two pressure slopes in one 8x8 local saddle solve; retain four velocity DOFs per internal face and one mean pressure per cell (one gauge removed). Reconstruct all eliminated fields after sparse LU.
method.force: native quadrature of f.R(v), compared with ordinary cell L2 load using identical stiffness, B, and boundary data. Arbitrary smooth force evaluated in native C++; Python only sparse linear algebra and actual-field comparisons.
method.traction: Native boundary residual of the full uncondensed form including body-force lift, compared to integral (2 nu sym G-pI)n. Both retained; no claim of equality on nonpolynomial unresolved fields.
method.pressure: kinematic static Stokes pressure, not Bernoulli. No rotational convection yet.
method.reference: P1 HHO spaces reused from user1695646; RT1 local constrained lift derived for this prototype, inspired by 2203.07180v3 Sections2.4/3.2; no claim of full theorem or whole-method implementation.

units: length m, velocity m/s, kinematic pressure m^2/s^2, divergence s^-1, integrated force m^3/s^2, energy-rate m^4/s^3 per unit density/depth. lambda=0 or10000 is dimensionless manufactured pressure amplitude, not acceptance threshold. Trace/constraint coefficients use dimensionless cell/Piola coordinates; load identity is coefficient per velocity basis. Algebraic residual mixed units is reported only.
failures: cut8 rejected by unchanged makeFvMesh2D Solver gate; no cells removed. Saved stdout/stderr.

Initial builds rejected misleading indentation under -Werror; corrected source, logs retained. Output-only readback revision initially failed build and a readback used old binary; final readbacks explicitly require a successful newer binary and correct this, with source/binary hashes retained.
validation: GCC13.3 C++20 O2 Werror; flow_face/flow_boundary/flow_branch_certificate CTest3/3. Standalone original P1 driver syntax check. No full101/101, frontend198/198, Electron, Mac, packaged application rerun.
cost: Each totalSeconds includes native geometry/assembly/RT1/local condensation, Python sparse conversion/LU/two algebraic refinements and native recovery/full-field export, excluding compilation. Concurrent cloud measurements, not exclusive benchmark. Additional final export readback is not another solve and reported separately. No eigenvalue or amplitude acceptance threshold.
limitations: No convection/time or original nonlinear branch repair. Cylinder no-slip static walls preserved but all outer velocities Dirichlet, unlike original product pressure outlet.
No new global traction boundary implementation. Traction is the reaction to imposed velocity; symmetric stress and load pairing actually used in solve.
RT1 reconstruction requires a positive centroid fan and roundoff-closed endpoints. This is an explicit prototype support restriction, not a replacement quality gate.
Sparse LU on 17260 cells has 124169041 factor entries; memory and scalable iterative/preconditioner cost still unresolved.
Higher-order manufactured pressure is improving; two physical Stokes meshes alone do not qualify local wall-pressure peaks, general curved wall accuracy, or all singular corners.
User is separately preparing stationary-wall closed manufactured P1 control; not included or claimed here.
